feeds.title: Malina Malkani Nutrition Blog
feeds.description: Learn about Baby-Led Weaning, how to deal with a picky eater and which food products are safe for your baby to eat. Malkani is a Registered Dietitian Nutritionist, member of the Forbes Health Advisory Board, former media spokesperson for the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics, and founder of Malina Malkani.

feeds.title: The Natural Parent Magazine » Baby Led Weaning
feeds.description: Learn about Baby Led Weaning in the Natural Parent Magazine. Get baby led weaning tips, kid's snack ideas, and more on how to ensure your child stays healthy. The Natural Parent Magazine is the leading parenting magazine both online and in print, for conscious parents.

feeds.title: Baby Led Feeding
feeds.description: Baby Led Feeding is a multi-award winning food blog sharing natural and wholesome recipes for babies that the entire family will also love. Discover all the latest news, tips and expert advice from Baby Led Feeding and Guests, allowing you to keep up to date with recipes, meal plans and more.

feeds.title: Alexander's Adventures with Baby Led Weaning
feeds.description: Our experience of baby-led weaning. I hope you find it useful and enjoy your journey as much as we're enjoying it!

feeds.title: Weaning World
feeds.description: Weaning World aims to bring you the very best resources, tips, advice, recipes, and products for every stage of your baby's or toddler's weaning and feeding journey.

feeds.title: Mummy to Dex » Baby Led Weaning
feeds.description: Here you can find a collection of baby led weaning Ideas (blw) recipes and stories about our baby led weaning journeys including hints and tips and wonderful products. Mummy to Dex is created and written by Nicola, a 35 year old Mum of two. She writes about her parenting journey and covers travel, family days out, pregnancy, interiors, baby led weaning and simple family recipes.

feeds.title: Ms. Dawn Blog
feeds.description: Visit our website often to read articles by Ms. Dawn, a feeding specialist and speech and language pathologist. Dawn Winkelmann has over 25 years of experience teaching parents, therapists, and caregivers how to feed children of all abilities. Dawn's areas of expertise are baby-led weaning (BLW), picky eating, and feeding children with medical or special needs.

feeds.title: Healthy Little Foodies » Baby Led Weaning Recipes
feeds.description: These baby-led weaning recipes are also great for traditionally weaned babies once they start finger foods. Low in sodium & full of fruit/veggies. I'm Amy Whiteford BSc (Hons) Food Science, PGDE (Primary), Cert Childhood Nutrition. I'm the recipe developer, photographer and voice behind Healthy Little Foodies.

feeds.title: Baby Led Weaning
feeds.description: I'm Natalie, a wife, and mother to my beautiful little girl Annabelle. This blog offers Quick & Easy Baby Led Weaning Recipes For Health Conscious Mums.

feeds.title: Weaning.ie Blog
feeds.description: Nutrition, News, and tips about feeding babies, children, and families. I'm Cathy, a Mum of 3 with over 15 years of experience in CHI @ Temple Street. As a Senior Paediatric Dietitian, I know how valuable it is to introduce families to the nurturing foundations of food before any problems begin.

feeds.title: First Step Nutrition » Baby led Weaning
feeds.description: Dietitian Jennifer House helps make starting solids fun, safe and healthy with baby-led weaning. Jennifer is passionate about helping parents make mealtimes more peaceful and raise children who have a healthy relationship with food. At First Step Nutrition, we offer online programs and individual consultations to cut through all of the nutrition noise and decrease the overwhelm and stress!
